blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Here, stand behind this bulk; straight will he come:
Wear thy good rapier bare, and put it home:
Quick, quick; fear nothing; I'll be at thy elbow:
It makes us, or it mars us; think on that,
And fix most firm thy resolution.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: Be near at hand; I may miscarry in't.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Here, at thy hand: be bold, and take thy stand.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: I have no great devotion to the deed;
And yet he hath given me satisfying reasons:
'Tis but a man gone. Forth, my sword: he dies.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: I have rubb'd this young quat almost to the sense,
And he grows angry. Now, whether he kill Cassio,
Or Cassio him, or each do kill the other,
Every way makes my gain: live Roderigo,
He calls me to a restitution large
Of gold and jewels that I bobb'd from him,
As gifts to Desdemona;
It must not be: if Cassio do remain,
He hath a daily beauty in his life
That makes me ugly; and, besides, the Moor
May unfold me to him; there stand I in much peril:
No, he must die. But so: I hear him coming.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: I know his gait, 'tis he.--Villain, thou diest!

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: That thrust had been mine enemy indeed,
But that my coat is better than thou know'st
I will make proof of thine.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: O, I am slain!

blocks.stage: IAGO from behind wounds CASSIO in the leg, and exit

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: I am maim'd for ever. Help, ho! murder! murder!

blocks.speaker: OTHELLO
lines: The voice of Cassio: Iago keeps his word.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: O, villain that I am!

blocks.speaker: OTHELLO
lines: It is even so.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: O, help, ho! light! a surgeon!

blocks.speaker: OTHELLO
lines: 'Tis he:--O brave Iago, honest and just,
That hast such noble sense of thy friend's wrong!
Thou teachest me. Minion, your dear lies dead,
And your unblest fate hies: strumpet, I come.
Forth of my heart those charms, thine eyes, are blotted;
Thy bed, lust-stain'd, shall with lust's blood be spotted.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: What, ho! no watch? no passage? murder! murder!

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: 'Tis some mischance; the cry is very direful.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: O, help!

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: Hark!

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: O wretched villain!

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: Two or three groan: it is a heavy night:
These may be counterfeits: let's think't unsafe
To come in to the cry without more help.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: Nobody come? then shall I bleed to death.

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: Hark!

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: Here's one comes in his shirt, with light and weapons.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Who's there? whose noise is this that ones on murder?

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: We do not know.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Did not you hear a cry?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Here, here! for heaven's sake, help me!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: What's the matter?

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: This is Othello's ancient, as I take it.

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: The same indeed; a very valiant fellow.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: What are you here that cry so grievously?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Iago? O, I am spoil'd, undone by villains!
Give me some help.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: O me, lieutenant! what villains have done this?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: I think that one of them is hereabout,
And cannot make away.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: O treacherous villains!
What are you there? come in, and give some help.

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: O, help me here!

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: That's one of them.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: O murderous slave! O villain!

blocks.speaker: RODERIGO
lines: O damn'd Iago! O inhuman dog!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Kill men i' the dark!--Where be these bloody thieves?--
How silent is this town!--Ho! murder! murder!--
What may you be? are you of good or evil?

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: As you shall prove us, praise us.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Signior Lodovico?

blocks.speaker: LODOVICO
lines: He, sir.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: I cry you mercy. Here's Cassio hurt by villains.

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: Cassio!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: How is't, brother!

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: My leg is cut in two.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Marry, heaven forbid!
Light, gentlemen; I'll bind it with my shirt.

blocks.speaker: BIANCA
lines: What is the matter, ho? who is't that cried?

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Who is't that cried!

blocks.speaker: BIANCA
lines: O my dear Cassio! my sweet Cassio! O Cassio,
Cassio, Cassio!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: O notable strumpet! Cassio, may you suspect
Who they should be that have thus many led you?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: No.

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: I am to find you thus: I have been to seek you.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Lend me a garter. So. O, for a chair,
To bear him easily hence!

blocks.speaker: BIANCA
lines: Alas, he faints! O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Gentlemen all, I do suspect this trash
To be a party in this injury.
Patience awhile, good Cassio. Come, come;
Lend me a light. Know we this face or no?
Alas my friend and my dear countryman
Roderigo! no:--yes, sure: O heaven! Roderigo.

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: What, of Venice?

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Even he, sir; did you know him?

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: Know him! ay.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Signior Gratiano? I cry you gentle pardon;
These bloody accidents must excuse my manners,
That so neglected you.

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: I am glad to see you.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: How do you, Cassio? O, a chair, a chair!

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: Roderigo!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: He, he 'tis he. [A chair brought in]
O, that's well said; the chair!

blocks.speaker: GRATIANO
lines: Some good man bear him carefully from hence;
I'll fetch the general's surgeon. [To BIANCA]
For you, mistress,
Save you your labour. He that lies slain
here, Cassio,
Was my dear friend: what malice was between you?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: None in the world; nor do I know the man.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: To BIANCA What, look you pale? O, bear him out
o' the air. [CASSIO and RODERIGO are borne off]
Stay you, good gentlemen. Look you pale, mistress?
Do you perceive the gastness of her eye?
Nay, if you stare, we shall hear more anon.
Behold her well; I pray you, look upon her:
Do you see, gentlemen? nay, guiltiness will speak,
Though tongues were out of use.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: 'Las, what's the matter? what's the matter, husband?

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Cassio hath here been set on in the dark
By Roderigo and fellows that are scaped:
He's almost slain, and Roderigo dead.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: Alas, good gentleman! alas, good Cassio!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: This is the fruit of whoring. Prithee, Emilia,
Go know of Cassio where he supp'd to-night. [To BIANCA]
What, do you shake at that?

blocks.speaker: BIANCA
lines: He supp'd at my house; but I therefore shake not.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: O, did he so? I charge you, go with me.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: Fie, fie upon thee, strumpet!

blocks.speaker: BIANCA
lines: I am no strumpet; but of life as honest
As you that thus abuse me.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: As I! foh! fie upon thee!

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: Kind gentlemen, let's go see poor Cassio dress'd.
Come, mistress, you must tell's another tale.
Emilia run you to the citadel,
And tell my lord and lady what hath happ'd.
Will you go on? I pray. [Aside]
This is the night
That either makes me or fordoes me quite.
